steps.failMessage: #boot-loader still covering the screen. It is removed from the DOM only once `booting` clears, which depends on sceneReady — measured 751ms and 36604ms across two runs of the SAME scenario, so no fixed wait covers it. Every screenshot before this point is the loader, and nothing fails (v0.31.9.6).

steps.name: place-a-known-wardrobe
steps.eval: (() => { const s = window.__store.getState(); const spec = { type: 'wardrobe', width: 1.2, height: 2.2, depth: 0.6, shelves: 'auto', doors: true, base: 'plinth', finish: 'painted', color: '#e8e4dc', compartments: [], deskLegs: 'legs', pedestalDrawers: 2, bays: 2, hasUppers: false, wardrobeFront: 'sliding', wardrobeFitOuts: [] }; const def = { id: 'user-carpentry-test-wardrobe', name: 'Custom wardrobe 120 x 220 cm', category: 'storage', kind: 'gltf', source: 'user', assetId: 'carpentry-test-wardrobe', uploadedAt: new Date().toISOString(), defaultFootprint: { w: 1.2, d: 0.6, h: 2.2 }, parametricSpec: JSON.stringify(spec) }; s.addUserFurniture(def); const room = s.floorPlan.rooms[0]; const pos = room ? [room.origin[0] + 0.8, room.origin[1] + 0.8] : [1, 1]; s.addItem({ defId: def.id, position: pos, rotation: 0, props: {} }); window.__wardrobeSpec = spec; })()

steps.name: intercept-window-open
steps.eval: window.open = () => ({ document: { write(h) { window.__capturedHtml = h }, close() {} }, close() {}, focus() {}, print() {} })

steps.name: assert-carpentry-sheet-content
steps.eval: (() => { const html = window.__capturedHtml; const need = (re, label) => { if (!re.test(html)) throw new Error('missing: ' + label) }; need(/Carpentry — Custom wardrobe 120 x 220 cm/, 'carpentry sheet title'); need(/FRONT ELEVATION/, 'front elevation label'); need(/SECTION A-A/, 'section A-A title (TODO H2 cut-line convention)'); need(/Verify all dimensions on site before fabrication\./, 'fabrication note'); need(/Overall width.{0,20}1200 mm/, 'overall width dimension in mm'); need(/Shelf 1 height AFF.{0,20}1862 mm/, 'shelf-height dimension in mm (hand-computed for this spec)'); need(/MATERIALS & FINISH/, 'materials/finish note block (TODO H2)'); need(/confirm exact board\/laminate code with fabricator/, 'honest materials hedge (TODO H2)'); need(/HARDWARE/, 'hardware note block (TODO H2)'); need(/Sliding track \+ rollers.{0,40}door panels/, 'sliding-wardrobe hardware callout (TODO H2)'); need(/class="section-cut"/, 'section cut-line marker on the elevation (TODO H2)'); window.__carpentryOk = true; })()

steps.name: duplicate-placement-two-more-times
steps.eval: (() => { const s = window.__store.getState(); const room = s.floorPlan.rooms[0]; const p2 = room ? [room.origin[0] + 1.6, room.origin[1] + 0.8] : [2, 1]; const p3 = room ? [room.origin[0] + 2.4, room.origin[1] + 0.8] : [3, 1]; s.addItem({ defId: 'user-carpentry-test-wardrobe', position: p2, rotation: 0, props: {} }); s.addItem({ defId: 'user-carpentry-test-wardrobe', position: p3, rotation: 0, props: {} }); })()

steps.name: assert-dedupe-note
steps.eval: (() => { const html = window.__capturedHtml; const count = (html.match(/FRONT ELEVATION/g) || []).length; if (count !== 1) throw new Error('expected exactly ONE carpentry sheet for 3 placements of the same piece, got ' + count); if (!/\(×3\)/.test(html)) throw new Error('missing ×3 dedupe note'); window.__dedupeOk = true; })()

steps.name: scroll-to-carpentry-sheet
steps.eval: (() => { const names = [...document.querySelectorAll('.tb-name')]; const nameEl = names.find((el) => el.textContent.trim().startsWith('Carpentry — Custom wardrobe')); const target = nameEl && nameEl.closest('.sheet'); if (!target) throw new Error('carpentry sheet not found in rendered document'); target.scrollIntoView(); })()
